notes: The first Salon de la Rose+Croix — Péladan’s first Geste esthétique. These records come from the illustrated catalogue’s works list, which is headed “Dessins” and prints no catalogue numbers, so no number is recorded for any work here; the book’s own note at the head of the list says that many drawings sent in late could not be included. Two entries print no title, and none has been supplied. The parse rests on Gallica’s OCR text of the Bibliothèque nationale de France digitisation, not on page images, so names and titles carry that text’s noise, and readings that had to be interpreted are flagged in the individual records. The Règle printed in the book says the salon closed on 9 April, though the Bibliothèque nationale de France dates the run to 10 April. John Finnegan’s compilation of these salons held only two Aman-Jean stub rows for 1892, with no works; the catalogue’s works list contains no Aman-Jean entry.
